title: Central Charm:5min to DT, Free Coffee! Uber Credit
description:
Looking for a cozy and comfortable stay in the heart of Nashville? Look no further! Our home features a fully equipped kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi, 2 Smart TVs, keyless entry, and free parking. Plus, enjoy onsite free washer and dryer facilities. With a baby crib and being less than 2 miles to Broadway (Bars) Bridgestone, Convention, and Music City Centers, and 1 mile to Marathon Music Works, it's perfect for a family or friends trip.

Book now and get a $30 Uber Credit for all Weekend bookings!

The space
Welcome to our central and spacious 2-story home nestled in a peaceful neighborhood yet conveniently close to the heart of the city. With an open-concept design and ample amenities, our property promises a comfortable and memorable stay for families, friends, or colleagues visiting Nashville. Here's why our home is the perfect choice for your stay:

Location:

⚃ Tucked away in a peaceful area, our home provides a serene retreat from the city noise.
⚃ Despite its peaceful surroundings, our home is just minutes away from downtown Nashville, offering easy access to popular attractions such as the Music City Center, Marathon Music Works, Bridgestone Arena, and more.
⚃ Convenient access to street parking along with 2 reserved parking spots for your convenience.

Exceptional Amenities:

⚃ Start your day with a fresh cup of coffee brewed with our Keurig machine, provided at no extra cost.
⚃ Stay entertained with 2 smart TVs, offering a variety of streaming options for your viewing pleasure.
⚃ Enjoy the convenience of a free in-unit washer and dryer, allowing you to pack light and keep your clothes fresh throughout your stay.
⚃ Rest comfortably in our well-appointed bedrooms, featuring a total of 6 beds - 2 Queen and 4 Full beds
⚃ Freshen up in the 2.5 baths (1 half bath on the 1st floor, 2 full baths on the 2nd floor), providing ample space and convenience for your daily routines.
⚃ Experience seamless entry with keyless access, eliminating the need for physical keys and enhancing security during your stay.
⚃ Stay connected with complimentary high-speed wireless internet, perfect for remote work or staying in touch with loved ones.

Additional Highlights:

⚃ Traveling with little ones? We've got you covered with a pack-and-play crib and high chair provided, ensuring a comfortable stay for the whole family.
⚃ Explore Nashville's vibrant nightlife and entertainment scene with a quick 5-7 minute Uber ride to Broadway and other popular destinations.
⚃ As a special bonus, guests who book weekend stays will receive a complimentary $30 credit, adding extra value to your Nashville experience.

Sleeping Arrangements:

⚃ Bedroom 1 (Second floor): This room features two Queen beds, perfect for couples or individuals who prefer extra space to stretch out and relax.
⚃ Bedroom 2 (Second floor): Ideal for kids or friends traveling together, this room is equipped with a Full over Full bunk bed, providing plenty of sleeping space without sacrificing comfort.
⚃ Bedroom 3 (Second floor): Another Full over Full bunk bed awaits in this room, along with a convenient couch that folds down into a Full-size bed, offering additional sleeping options for larger groups or families.

Whether you're here for business or leisure, our home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and affordability. Book your stay with us and make unforgettable memories in Music City!

Guest access
During your stay, you'll enjoy exclusive access to the entire home, providing you with a private and personalized experience. From the moment you arrive, the space is all yours to explore, relax, and make lasting memories. With no shared spaces or interruptions, you have the freedom to truly unwind and embrace the comfort of having the entire home at your disposal!

Other things to note
ATTENTION LOCAL GUESTS: All locals must send an 'inquiry' first using the 'Contact Host' option on the booking page to state the purpose of your visit, so we can check to see if we would be able to accommodate your stay; otherwise, we reserve the right to cancel any confirmed reservation made without our approval.
